description:
**Draughtsman**

**Department:** Design / Engineering Department **Designation:** Draughtsman **Reporting To:** Architect / Design Manager / Project Engineer

**Job Summary**

The Draughtsman is responsible for preparing accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings, detailed plans, sections, elevations, and execution drawings based on project requirements and design standards. The role involves coordinating with architects, engineers, and site teams to ensure drawing accuracy, proper documentation, timely revisions, and smooth project execution.

**Key Duties \& Responsibilities1\. Technical Drawing Preparation**

* Prepare accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings using AutoCAD and related drafting software.
* Develop plans, sections, elevations, and detailed drawings as per project requirements.
* Ensure drawings comply with company standards and technical specifications.
* Cross\-check dimensions, scales, and annotations before final submission.
* Update and revise drawings based on design changes and site feedback.

**2\. Coordination \& Communication**

* Coordinate with architects, engineers, and site teams for drawing requirements.
* Attend site visits and meetings to collect technical information when required.
* Clarify technical drawing details with execution teams.
* Alert the team regarding design clashes or drafting issues.
* Support project teams in day\-to\-day drawing and documentation activities.

**3\. Drawing Verification \& Documentation**

* Review drawings for accuracy before issue and execution.
* Maintain systematic backups and digital archives of all drawings.
* Provide printed drawing sets for site and consultant teams when required.
* Maintain records of drawing revisions and daily work updates.
* Ensure proper document filing and project drawing organization.

**4\. Project Support \& Timeline Management**

* Support execution teams with drawing\-related clarifications.
* Ensure project drawing submissions are completed within deadlines.
* Coordinate with supervisors for design and project coordination.
* Monitor drawing status and maintain workflow efficiency.
* Help ensure project timelines related to drawings are achieved.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Diploma / Certification in Drafting, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and other drafting software.
* Knowledge of architectural and interior detailed drawings.
* Understanding of construction drawings, dimensions, and technical standards.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple drawing tasks and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation management.

**KPI Indicators \& Expected Performance Standards**

**KPI Indicator**

**Expected Performance Standard**

Drawing Accuracy

98% error\-free technical drawings

Timely Submission

100% drawings issued within deadlines

Revision Efficiency

Drawing revisions completed within 24 hrs

Coordination Efficiency

Smooth coordination with project teams

Documentation Management

Proper filing and backup of all drawings

Technical Compliance

Drawings aligned with company standards

**Expected Performance Standards**

* Deliver accurate and detailed technical drawings consistently.
* Ensure all drawings are completed within approved timelines.
* Maintain proper drawing documentation and revision control.
* Coordinate effectively with architects, engineers, and site teams.
* Minimize drafting errors and technical discrepancies.
* Follow company drafting standards and project procedures.

**Growth Opportunity**

The Draughtsman role provides opportunities for career growth in technical drafting, architectural detailing, design coordination, and project management. Employees demonstrating strong technical knowledge, drafting accuracy, and project coordination skills can progress into Senior Draughtsman, Design Coordinator, CAD Manager, or Project Design roles within the organization.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Drafting: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Junior Architect
description:
We are looking for a **passionate and motivated Fresher / Junior Architect** to join our architectural design team in Kochi. The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in architecture, design, visualization, and detailing, along with a willingness to learn and grow in a professional studio environment.

As a Junior Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior architects and designers across various stages of projects — from **concept development and design to working drawings, 3D visualization, documentation, and site execution**.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in architectural design development and concept preparation.
* Prepare plans, elevations, sections, working drawings, and presentation drawings.
* Develop and modify 3D models and architectural visualizations.
* Assist in material selection, detailing, and design development.
* Participate in site visits, measurements, and site documentation.
* Coordinate with senior architects, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
* Assist with project documentation and maintain organized drawing sets.
* Contribute creative ideas and design solutions during the development of projects.
* Support the team in ensuring design intent is maintained through the execution stage.

Requirements

* **Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch)** from a recognized institution.
* Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply; **0–1 year of experience** is an advantage.
* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD and SketchUp**.
* Familiarity with **Lumion, Enscape, Photoshop, Revit, or other visualization/design software** will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of architectural drawings, materials, and basic construction detailing.
* Strong visual and design sense.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work responsibly within deadlines.
* Most importantly, a **willingness to learn, take initiative, and grow with the team**.

What We Offer

* Exposure to a diverse range of architectural projects.
* Hands\-on experience in design, documentation, visualization, and site execution.
* A collaborative and learning\-oriented studio environment.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced architects and designers.
* Scope for professional and creative growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their **CV and portfolio** showcasing their academic, personal, or professional work.

title: BIM Coordinator – Revit & Navisworks
description:
BIM COORDINATOR

**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Industry:** Architecture \| Engineering \| BIM \| Project Management

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **BIM Coordinator** with **3–5 years of relevant professional experience** to join our multidisciplinary design team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and coordinating BIM deliverables across disciplines, ensuring model accuracy, quality, consistency, and compliance with project\-specific BIM standards. The role requires strong technical proficiency in **Autodesk Revit and Navisworks**, along with the ability to effectively coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants, and project teams.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of BIM methodologies and demonstrate the ability to identify coordination issues, manage model development, and contribute to the successful implementation of BIM workflows across projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and coordinate **multidisciplinary BIM models** throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop, review, and maintain high\-quality **Revit models** in accordance with project requirements and established BIM standards.
* Coordinate **Architectural, Structural, and MEP models** and ensure effective interdisciplinary integration.
* Conduct **clash detection and model coordination** using Navisworks Manage and identify critical design conflicts.
* Review coordination reports and work closely with respective disciplines to ensure timely resolution of clashes and discrepancies.
* Carry out regular **BIM model audits, quality control, and compliance checks**.
* Ensure adherence to project\-specific **BIM standards, naming conventions, modelling protocols, and documentation requirements**.
* Monitor BIM deliverables and coordinate with project teams to ensure timely submission of models and drawings.
* Assist in the preparation, implementation, and maintenance of **BIM Execution Plans (BEP), BIM standards, workflows, and project protocols**.
* Maintain proper model structure, worksets, linked models, shared coordinates, families, and other BIM\-related project information.
* Participate in BIM coordination meetings and effectively communicate technical and coordination issues to relevant stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and support to **BIM Modellers, Architects, and other project team members**.
* Identify opportunities to improve BIM processes, workflows, and overall project efficiency.
* Support the implementation of BIM best practices and digital project delivery standards within the organization.

Technical Competencies

**Mandatory:**

* Advanced proficiency in **Autodesk Revit**.
* Strong working knowledge of **Navisworks Manage**.
* Good understanding of BIM coordination and multidisciplinary workflows.
* Knowledge of Architectural BIM modelling and documentation.
* Understanding of coordination between **Architecture, Structure, and MEP disciplines**.
* Experience in clash detection, coordination, and model quality control.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with **Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM Collaborate Pro**.
* Knowledge of BIM 360 workflows and Common Data Environment (CDE).
* Familiarity with BIM Execution Plans.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, SketchUp, or other relevant design/BIM software.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related discipline**.
* Professional qualification or certification in **BIM / Architectural BIM** will be an added advantage.

Desired Candidate Profile

* **3–5 years of relevant experience** in BIM coordination, preferably within an architectural consultancy, multidisciplinary design firm, PMC, or similar professional environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent understanding of BIM processes and model coordination.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deliverables within defined timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to model quality.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Proactive approach towards identifying and resolving coordination issues.
* Ability to mentor and provide technical support to junior BIM team members.

Key Performance Areas

* BIM model quality and accuracy
* Multidisciplinary model coordination
* Clash detection and resolution
* Compliance with BIM standards and project protocols
* Timely BIM deliverables
* Effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders
* Continuous improvement of BIM workflows and processes

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹85,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
